implementation.scopeBoundary: Only the owning repository's Search byte-pattern compiler, diagnostics, focused tests and proposed contract documentation changed, plus this scope's evidence. The Search SQL constructor remains unadvertised and no sibling repository or publication state was changed.
implementation.schema: Version 1 requires a JSON object with integer version 1 and a bytes string. Bytes are compact or whitespace-separated pairs of hex nibbles; '?' wildcards compile to nibble masks. An optional same-length mask string supplies bit-level comparison masks and cannot coexist with wildcard nibbles.
implementation.semanticBoundary: Compiled byte order is exactly the order written. Numeric JSON/SQL values, 0x prefixes and endianness options are rejected or diagnosed; no conversion or guessed byte array interpretation occurs.
implementation.safetyBoundary: Input size is bounded before JSON parsing, duplicate and unknown properties are rejected, invalid syntax/arguments use SEARCH-SYNTAX-003, and compiled byte/mask arrays are copied into equal-length read-only memory.

scenarios: Exact bytes compile with an implicit full mask.
Nibble wildcards compile to exact byte and mask sequences, including all-wildcard bytes.
Explicit nibble masks compile with preserved byte order.
Odd hex, invalid bytes, numeric-like prefixes, empty patterns, conflicts, versions and duplicate properties produce actionable typed diagnostics.
